Shingle Roof Cost by State

How Geographic Location Affects Roof Replacement Costs: Across the United States, replacing a residential asphalt shingle roof on an average 2,000 square foot home ranges from approximately $7,400 to $18,500. Regional pricing is heavily driven by prevailing skilled trade labor wages, local building permit fees, cold-climate ice dam mandates, and hurricane windborne debris codes.

51-State Shingle Roof Replacement Cost Table

Estimating Methodology & Data Sources

Our regional cost indices are compiled by tracking regional construction wage statistics from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), municipal permit fee schedules, and insurance claim loss benchmarks. Actual project bids vary based on home height, slope pitch, accessibility, and material selection.
